userStories.title: Add Supabase Auth to backend
userStories.description: Integrate Supabase Auth for user authentication in the backend. Create auth middleware that validates JWT tokens from Supabase. Add current_user dependency for protected routes. Update User model to link with Supabase auth.users via auth_id field.
acceptanceCriteria: File backend/src/api/auth.py exists with get_current_user dependency
Auth middleware validates Supabase JWT tokens
User model has auth_id field (UUID, nullable for migration)
New alembic migration adds auth_id column
Protected routes return 401 without valid token
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Add Supabase Auth to frontend
userStories.description: Integrate Supabase Auth in the frontend using @supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs. Create auth context provider, login page, signup page, and logout functionality. Protect dashboard routes with auth middleware.
acceptanceCriteria: File frontend/src/lib/auth.tsx exists with auth provider
Dashboard routes redirect to login if not authenticated
Auth state persists across page refreshes

userStories.title: Create user onboarding wizard
userStories.description: Create a multi-step onboarding flow after signup: Step 1 - Enter name and phone number, Step 2 - Select timezone, Step 3 - Set first call schedule. Store progress and redirect to dashboard on completion.
acceptanceCriteria: Creates user record and schedule on completion

userStories.title: Create UserPreferences model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy UserPreferences model in backend/src/models/preferences.py with fields: id, user_id (FK unique), conversation_topics (JSON array), interests (JSON array), communication_style (enum: casual, formal, friendly), call_duration_preference (enum: short, medium, long), created_at, updated_at.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to User with unique constraint
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create UserPreferences API endpoints
userStories.description: Create CRUD endpoints for user preferences in backend/src/api/routes/preferences.py: GET /preferences (get current user's preferences), PUT /preferences (create or update), DELETE /preferences. Preferences are per-user, not a collection.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /preferences returns current user's preferences or 404
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create ConversationMemory model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy ConversationMemory model in backend/src/models/memory.py to store important facts from conversations: id, user_id (FK indexed), memory_type (enum: fact, preference, event, relationship), content (text), source_call_id (FK nullable), importance (int 1-10), created_at. This enables personalization.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign keys to User and Call
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create memory extraction service
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/memory_service.py that uses Claude to extract memorable facts from call transcripts. Extract: personal facts, preferences mentioned, upcoming events, relationships mentioned. Store as ConversationMemory records.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses Claude to identify key facts
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create memory retrieval for agent context
userStories.description: Create function in memory_service.py to retrieve relevant memories for a user to include in agent prompts. Get recent memories, high-importance memories, and memories related to current date (birthdays, events). Format for LLM context.
acceptanceCriteria: Function get_user_context(user_id) -> str returns formatted memories
Returns formatted string for LLM prompt injection
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create MoodAnalysis model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy MoodAnalysis model in backend/src/models/mood.py: id, call_id (FK unique), overall_sentiment (enum: positive, neutral, negative, concerned), confidence (float 0-1), flags (JSON array of concern types), notes (text), analyzed_at (datetime). One analysis per call.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to Call with unique constraint
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create mood analysis service
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/mood_service.py that uses Claude to analyze call transcripts for mood and concerns. Detect: confusion, distress, loneliness, health concerns, unusual behavior. Return structured analysis with confidence scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Uses Claude to detect sentiment and concerns
Flags array contains specific concern types
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create mood analysis API endpoint
userStories.description: Add endpoint POST /calls/{id}/analyze-mood in calls router that runs mood analysis on a completed call. Store result in database. Return the analysis. Also add mood data to CallReadWithDetails response.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 400 if call has no transcripts
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create APScheduler service
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/scheduler_service.py that uses APScheduler to manage scheduled calls. On startup, load all enabled schedules and create jobs. Provide functions to add/remove/update scheduled jobs. Jobs should call the trigger endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Jobs trigger calls via internal function (not HTTP)
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Integrate scheduler with app lifecycle
userStories.description: Update backend/src/main.py to start the scheduler on app startup and shut it down gracefully on shutdown. Update schedule CRUD endpoints to also update APScheduler jobs when schedules are created/updated/deleted.
acceptanceCriteria: Scheduler starts on app startup event
Scheduler shuts down on app shutdown event
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Update voice agent with memory context
userStories.description: Update backend/src/agent/standup_agent.py to fetch user memories before starting conversation. Include relevant memories in the system prompt so the agent can reference past conversations and personalize the interaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Agent fetches user memories on session start
System prompt includes personalization section with memories
Agent can reference user's name, preferences, past topics
Memory context formatted clearly for LLM
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create post-call processing pipeline
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/post_call_service.py that runs after a call completes: 1) Generate summary, 2) Extract memories, 3) Analyze mood, 4) Post to Slack if configured. Call this from the agent when conversation ends.
acceptanceCriteria: Posts to Slack if user has Slack configured
Handles errors gracefully (one failure doesn't stop others)
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create analytics data aggregation
userStories.description: Create backend/src/services/analytics_service.py with functions to compute user analytics: total_calls, total_duration_minutes, average_call_duration, calls_this_week, calls_this_month, mood_trend (array of recent sentiments), streak_days (consecutive days with calls).
acceptanceCriteria: Computes all metrics listed in description
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create analytics API endpoint
userStories.description: Create GET /users/me/analytics endpoint that returns analytics for the current authenticated user. Include all metrics from analytics_service.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns UserAnalytics schema with all metrics
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Create analytics dashboard page
userStories.description: Create frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/analytics/page.tsx showing user analytics: call stats cards, mood trend chart (simple bar/line), call history timeline, streak display. Use React Query to fetch data.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows total calls, average duration, streak

userStories.title: Create settings page with preferences
userStories.description: Create frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx with sections: Profile (name, email, phone, timezone), Preferences (topics, interests, communication style), Notifications (Slack toggle), Danger Zone (delete account). Use React Query mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Preferences section with multi-select for topics/interests

userStories.title: Add mood indicator to call detail page
userStories.description: Update frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/calls/[id]/page.tsx to display mood analysis if available: sentiment badge (colored), confidence percentage, any flags/concerns highlighted, analysis notes. Add 'Analyze Mood' button if not yet analyzed.
acceptanceCriteria: Mood section displays sentiment with color-coded badge
Displays flags as warning badges if present

userStories.title: Add memories tab to call detail page
userStories.description: Update call detail page to include a 'Memories' tab showing memories extracted from this call. Display memory type badge, content, and importance. Add 'Extract Memories' button if not yet extracted.
acceptanceCriteria: Memories tab/section on call detail page
Extract Memories button if no memories exist

userStories.title: Create Twilio webhook handler
userStories.description: Create backend/src/api/routes/webhooks.py with POST /webhooks/twilio/incoming endpoint to handle inbound calls. Validate Twilio signature, create call record, return TwiML to connect to LiveKit room. This enables 24/7 inbound calling.
acceptanceCriteria: Looks up user by phone number
Creates call record with status in_progress
Returns TwiML XML to connect to LiveKit SIP
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Add call direction tracking
userStories.description: Update Call model to include direction field (enum: inbound, outbound). Update trigger endpoint to set direction=outbound. Update Twilio webhook to set direction=inbound. Update UI to show direction badge on calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Call model has direction field with default outbound
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Enhance dashboard home with insights
userStories.description: Update frontend/src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx to show richer insights: mood trend mini-chart, recent memories carousel, upcoming scheduled call countdown, quick stats (calls this week, streak). Make it feel like a personalized home.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows mini mood trend (last 5 calls)
Quick stats row (calls this week, current streak)

userStories.title: Add alert notifications for concerning moods
userStories.description: Create Alert model (id, user_id, call_id, alert_type, message, acknowledged, created_at). When mood analysis flags concerns, create an alert. Show alert banner on dashboard. Allow dismissing alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: Mood service creates alerts for negative/concerned sentiment
GET /alerts endpoint for user's unacknowledged alerts
Dashboard shows alert banner if unacknowledged alerts exist
uv run ruff check src/ passes

userStories.title: Write integration tests for new features
userStories.description: Add integration tests for: auth middleware, preferences CRUD, mood analysis endpoint, analytics endpoint, webhook handler. Ensure all new endpoints have test coverage.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests for auth middleware (valid token, invalid token, missing token)
Tests for Twilio webhook (with mocked signature)
All tests pass: uv run pytest tests/ -v
